productOverview.headline: The Benchmark Survey Drone
productOverview.description: The DJI Phantom 4 RTK remains a proven, reliable choice for cadastral and engineering mapping, pairing a mechanical shutter camera with seamless RTK integration for high mapping accuracy.

keyFeatures.headline: Key Features
keyFeatures.description: Why the Phantom 4 RTK remains an industry benchmark.

items.title: 1-Inch CMOS Camera
items.description: 20 MP resolution with a mechanical shutter for distortion-free mapping imagery.

items.title: Seamless RTK Integration
items.description: Delivers ±1-2 cm horizontal and ±2-3 cm vertical accuracy in the field.

items.title: Proven Reliability
items.description: A long-standing industry standard for cadastral and engineering surveys.

items.title: High Mapping Accuracy
items.description: GSD of ~2.7 cm at 100 m altitude for detailed orthomosaics.
